name: mirage
text: Not on its own. The wallet balance is only one total number, so it can't give day-by-day profit, per-bet results, closing-line value or the filters on the Tracker. What can carry it is Novig's own fill and settlement history, which has each bet with its price, stake and result. Your all-time profit already uses the wallet plus Novig's money-in and money-out ledger. A Tracker built from Novig's history on GitHub is possible, and the phone would only show it. What I haven't verified is how far back Novig returns that history and whether it covers your hand bets. I'll check that first and tell you before building anything. I haven't started yet.
